releaseNotes:
• Official Signed Release v1.0.9 (Build 10)
• In-App Updater Reliability: Automatic check on app launch & resume with direct streaming download
• Incoming & Outgoing Message Alignment: Uses authenticated Firebase UID as the authoritative source of truth
• Own messages appear on the RIGHT with vibrant gradient bubbles; peer messages appear on the LEFT with avatar and frosted white bubbles
• Add to Contacts: Input placeholder clearly displays 'Contact name (e.g. Rahul)' when empty without pre-filling; dialog shows peer Gmail address
• Chats Screen Background: Added subtle, lightweight floating animated bubbles behind the chat list with pastel pink, purple, and light blue palette
• Zero data loss: Preserves all existing contacts, chat history, and sidebar auto-hide behavior
